claims.statement: the level-12 source-first ζ(5) construction has an exact weight-6 source with L(G,5)=(144/25)ζ(5), an integral first row related algebraically to the square of the Domb period, a genuine two-index binomial formula, an exact companion B=FD^(-5)G, all-n integrality A_n ∈ Z, and d_n^5 B_n ∈ Z
claims.notes: Identified as strongest result in the project. Requires proof of W_12 Eichler/Fricke transformation before submission.

claims.statement: For even weight k, the number of independent annihilation conditions is q(k)=1+⌊k/4⌋, and if h_ε(N) is the appropriate Fricke eigenspace dimension, the annihilation matrix has maximal rank min(q(k),h_ε(N)), giving dimA_N,k^ε = max(0,h_ε(N)−q(k))
claims.notes: Core theorem in classification theory; should become theorem-and-classification paper

claims.statement: For three meromorphic Cooper cases s_7, s_10, s_18: (n+1)|A_n for every n, which makes the first Eichler integration arithmetically free and gives d_n^2 B_n ∈ Z instead of d_n^3
claims.notes: Connects congruence/divisibility theory directly to effective weight of Apéry construction
